assertions.title: Deployment creation and listing works

steps.action: Open /get-started in an isolated signed-in browser session.
steps.expected: The deployment workspace is accessible with the isolated account and built artifact available for selection.
steps.observed: Signed-in state rendered correctly for e2e-pipeline-ut+browser-r2-20260315105356@example.com with Sign Out visible, and the deployment form allowed selecting project proj_7985 plus built artifact bld_3e05327c74105198c211f1ea.

steps.action: Submit a preview deployment with target ref browser-deploy-r2-1773572808818 and runtime env entries.
steps.expected: A success result card shows deployment ID, status, domain, reachable endpoint link, and resource profile.
steps.observed: POST /api/v1/deployments returned 202 and the UI rendered Deployment Created for dep_4daefb57968da6be8128a10b, but the result card stayed at status starting and showed Reachable Endpoint = "Waiting for runtime endpoint..." instead of a link.

steps.action: Verify the filtered deployments/domains lists and open View Logs from the created deployment.
steps.expected: The project filter narrows the list to the created deployment, the domains list refreshes, and View Logs opens the modal.
steps.observed: Immediately after submit, the filtered deployment and domain cards appeared for proj_7985 but still showed starting / no endpoint. After manual Refresh Deployments and Refresh Domains, both cards updated to running with runtime endpoint http://janus-runner:35365/. View Logs opened a modal for Deployment Logs - dep_4daefb57968da6be8128a10b with 4 visible lines.

evidence.consoleErrors: Console captured one RSC fallback fetch error for /sign-in navigation and repeated "Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 500" errors caused by GET /api/v1/builds/bld_3e05327c74105198c211f1ea/logs/stream while the log modal auto-updated.
evidence.network: POST /api/v1/auth/session/exchange -> 200; GET /api/v1/auth/me -> 200; GET /api/v1/projects -> 200; GET /api/v1/builds -> 200; POST /api/v1/deployments -> 202 with projectId=proj_7985 buildJobId=bld_3e05327c74105198c211f1ea; immediate GET /api/v1/deployments and GET /api/v1/domains -> 200 showing dep_4daefb57968da6be8128a10b / e2e-pipeline-ut-browser-r2-20260315105356-1.janus.run in starting state; manual browser refreshes later showed running cards with http://janus-runner:35365/; GET /api/v1/builds/bld_3e05327c74105198c211f1ea/logs -> 200; repeated GET /api/v1/builds/bld_3e05327c74105198c211f1ea/logs/stream -> 500.

assertions.issues: VAL-FH-018 still fails because the immediate Deployment Created result card does not satisfy the assertion requirement for a reachable endpoint link (it remains "Waiting for runtime endpoint...") and the post-submit list refresh initially stays in starting state even though the deployment becomes running shortly afterward.

frictions.description: The assigned agent-browser session became unstable when using screenshot commands; the daemon disconnected twice while the authenticated /get-started page was loaded.
frictions.resolution: Closed/restarted only the isolated agent-browser session, then captured the required screenshots with a single isolated Playwright browser context while keeping the same isolated user/project data.

frictions.description: Opening the deployment log modal triggered repeated failed /logs/stream auto-update requests that surfaced as console/network 500s.
frictions.resolution: The modal still rendered stable log content from GET /api/v1/builds/{buildId}/logs, so the assertion was testable, but the SSE/stream failures remain visible evidence.

summary: Tested 1 assertion. Deployment creation, project filtering, domains listing, and the View Logs modal all worked through the real browser surface, and a manual refresh later showed the deployment/domain running at http://janus-runner:35365/. However, the immediate Deployment Created result card still stops at status starting with no reachable endpoint link, so VAL-FH-018 remains a fail rather than a pass.
